name: L-Shape Electric Standing Desk 80x60, Light Wood/Slate

dimensions.raw: Product page: "Dimensions 25-50.5"(H) x 79.5"(W) x 60"(D)", "Size 79.5"(W) x 60"(D)". Spec sheet (L-shape_esdce_80x60_spec-sheet-2026): top view "80" (203.2 cm)" by "60" (152.4 cm)", each desktop "27 ½" (70 cm)" deep, inside edges "52" (132 cm)" and "32 ¼" (82 cm)" (to the start of the inner curve); "Dimensions: 80" x 60" x 27 ½""; "Lift Range: 25" – 50 ½""; "Desktop Thickness: 1 ¼""; "Weight Capacity: 200 lb"
dimensions.source: vari.com product page and its spec sheet PDF, read in Claude in Chrome 2026-10-25 with Light Wood/Slate selected (SKU 402451). w = 80, the spec sheet's drawing (the page's row says 79.5; the larger is kept); d = 60; h = the top of the lift range; notch (80 - 27.5) x (60 - 27.5) = 52.5 x 32.5, on the right as drawn: the short desktop on the user's left. "configure the short desktop on the left or right to your preference" (spec sheet)

notes: Flags: none. The largest Vari L that fits the office (Andrew, 2026-10-25: "vari L desk or multiple vari straight ones (bamboo), largest htat can fit"), staged in back-bedroom g: its 80" main along the left wall and the 60" return across the room leave 46" for the way in from the door (the 80x80, other-vari-402764, leaves 26"). No bamboo at Vari (vari.com's search for "bamboo" finds nothing); Light Wood is its nearest finish, pale like bamboo. ComfortEdge front, "reversible configuration". SKU 402451; "In stock, Free standard shipping" (2026-10-25); 30-day returns, lifetime warranty; 4.8 stars (141). Photos are on www.vari.com, not an allowed photo host yet (needs Andrew's word), so none are downloaded. rooms: back-bedroom, from the brief.
